campaign.title: High-pass log-dilation commutator in the projected alpha comb

resource_policy.literature_policy: Search primary literature only after an exact Mellin-commutator kernel matches a named multiplier or variation theorem; audit all hypotheses before import.

frozen_target.question: Does the zero at beta=0 of the high-pass factor 1-psi(beta) turn the projected alpha cosine comb into a target-sized logarithmic dilation commutator, or do the actual lattice/floor jumps retain the X^(1/8) normalized capacity?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Start from the proved Round-49 masked cosine-comb reduction on one common finite antecedent. Write the inverse beta-height multiplier of 1-psi(beta) as delta_0-check(psi), keep the bounded-alpha factor psi(alpha), and retain every A-strip connector, u/v face, positive axis, mixed connector, corner, signed top/height operation, radial R1 factor, actual profile, floor, star, and the sole external X^(1/4) factor.
quantities: inverse Fourier convention and zero-mass high-pass kernel
logarithmic dilation difference of the cosine/Dirac comb amplitude
Cauchy-Pompeiu or two strip-edge A connectors
u/v faces, axes, connector axes, mixed connector, and one corner
signed top Plemelj and joint outside-height limit
actual scales, H_j+1 floors, profiles, product stars, and radial bracket

completion_criteria: An exact finite high-pass commutator formula is derived without replacing the masked branch by the pure comb.
The zero-mass identity and all Fourier/Mellin constants, signs, and dilation variables are audited.
The bounded-alpha factor and every connector, face, axis, corner, and A=0 ownership term remain on the same antecedent.
A proposed BV/difference saving is tested on exact lattice points, dyadic profile boundaries, height floors, and stars.
The signed Plemelj and height-limit order is preserved before absolute values.
The full h,q,j,x and external X powers are tracked through any claimed gain.
At least one clean statement-only derivation and one independent hostile audit exist.
No alpha bound or downstream wrapper is promoted without the complete normalized estimate and outside-height limit.

tasks.target: Derive the complete finite log-dilation commutator for the alpha share and prove a normalized O(X^epsilon) BV/difference estimate, or isolate the first exact actual-profile term that prevents it.
required_output: exact commutator formula and owner ledger
target estimate or first sharp survivor

tasks.target: Independently derive the zero-mass log-dilation commutator from the frozen packet, test it against lattice/floor discontinuities, and prove the target bound or state the first missing quantitative hypothesis.

Hostile-audit the proposed high-pass saving for hidden delta terms, false zero moments, loss at exact lattice/floor jumps, missing connectors or faces, illicit absolute height exchange, and incorrect X normalization; construct an actual-profile or scoped adversarial obstruction if possible.

review_seams.requirement: Verify the inverse Fourier/Mellin convention, zero mass, dilation variable, and bounded-alpha coupling exactly.
Keep the high-pass bulk, A connector, u/v faces, axes, mixed connector, corner, and A=0 routing on one finite antecedent.
Test any BV claim at lattice points, dyadic edges, H_j floors, product stars, and endpoint prefixes.
Preserve Plemelj-before-absolute order and audit the height, radial, coefficient, scale, and external X powers.
The blind proof sees only the Round-50 derivation packet and its brief.
